content.text:
Perfect! The sum matches exactly. This is a classic lump_sum (lender disbursal) pattern where:
- A single payment covers invoices for multiple students named in the payment notes
- All five students mentioned in the payment match the invoices in the candidates list
- The total amount (29,000,000 paise) equals the sum of all five invoices

input.rationale: Loan disbursal payment of ₹29,00,00,000 from Vidya Finserv covers invoices for all five named students: Isha Malhotra (₹9,00,000), Nisha Hegde (₹5,00,000), Pari Bose (₹5,00,000), Om Bhat (₹5,00,000), and Aarav Mishra (₹5,00,000). Total sum matches exactly: 9M + 5M + 5M + 5M + 5M = 29M paise.
